<ParamField body="action" type="ReactNode">
  Optional trailing ReactNode. Compose Button, links or multiple controls with their complete public APIs.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="children" type="ReactNode">
  Caller-provided content. Standard plain strings truncate with a focusable tooltip; rich nodes render directly. Compact content wraps.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="className" type="string">
  Class merged onto the root div or composed element.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="color" type="&quot;blue&quot; | &quot;gray&quot; | &quot;green&quot; | &quot;orange&quot; | &quot;red&quot;" default="status palette">
  Gray, blue, green, orange or red palette override. An omitted color follows status.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="embedded" type="boolean" default="false">
  Removes the standard bottom margin. Compact layouts have no bottom margin.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="icon" type="ReactNode" default="decorative information icon">
  Leading ReactNode. Defaults to a decorative information icon. Pass null to omit it.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="layout" type="&quot;compact&quot; | &quot;standard&quot;" default="standard">
  Standard full-width layout or compact wrapping layout with a 512px maximum content width. Defaults to standard.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="ref" type="Ref&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;">
  Ref to the root div, or to the DOM element supplied through render.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="render" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | ComponentRenderFn&lt;HTMLProps, BannerState&gt;">
  Base UI root element or render callback, receiving native props/ref and resolved Banner state.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="status" type="&quot;error&quot; | &quot;info&quot; | &quot;neutral&quot; | &quot;success&quot; | &quot;warning&quot;" default="info">
  Feedback meaning: neutral, info, success, warning or error. Defaults to info. Roles and announcements remain caller-owned.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="style" type="CSSProperties">
  Inline styles applied to the root div or composed element.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="variant" type="&quot;soft&quot; | &quot;solid&quot;" default="soft">

</ParamField>
